start.dialog: I buried a time capsule fifty years ago with a message to my future self! But I never found it! Can you help me locate it? The temporal coordinates are encrypted in this childhood diary! Solve the puzzle, find the capsule!
start.objective: Decrypt the childhood diary to find the time capsule location

progress.dialog: The coordinates point to what is now the town square fountain! But it's buried deep, and the town won't let us dig without proof! Find another way—maybe a temporal phase shift to reach it without disturbing the fountain!
progress.objective: Use temporal phasing to retrieve the time capsule non-destructively

complete.dialog: The capsule! My childhood treasures! And the letter... *tears* I had forgotten my childhood dreams. Thank you for returning them to me. Here, take this Time Capsule Token! It can store items outside of time—retrieve them anytime, anywhere!

party_comments.kade: He cried reading his own letter. I'm not crying, you're crying!
party_comments.twist: Messages across time are powerful. The child he was spoke truth.
party_comments.nix7: Personal time capsule retrieval: successful. Emotional value: high.
